question: Does adding Hangzhou stopped-queue discharge measured at Jinan's native accel improve fixed high-arm predictions on untouched Jinan seeds?
native_target: Use the same native Jinan network, vehicle parameters, PP prefix and phase executor as inputs.json. Use the original two straight vehicle IDs in order of stop-line distance. Outcome is entry by t+10 inclusive of the second vehicle under the preselected high request.

frozen_predictions.notation: T = native Jinan rate at this point, A = Hangzhou rate at this point after both cars receive accel 2.0, H = native Hangzhou rate at this point. Pooling all development cases gives T_pool=3/15 and A_pool=1/9.
frozen_predictions.weights: Use exactly one half wherever shown; all prediction arms share the six strata, development target labels and test cases. No calibration on evaluation seeds.

selection: Take a 3600-second PP preaction census at the existing ten-second cadence for each seed. Use the previous Jinan opportunity rule: eight candidates, high/low nominal straight priority exposure 4/0, six fixed right/straight counts. Additionally require exactly zero speed for both front straight vehicles at t0. For each seed iterate points lexicographically, take the earliest eligible epoch then lexicographically first (tls_id,right_id,straight_id), skipping already used times and continuous both-supplied visits as in the existing selector. Freeze all rosters before opening branch outcomes.
coverage: Require all six points in each of the four seeds for a balanced comparison. If coverage fails, report the missing cells and stop before branch replay; do not replace a seed, point or cohort.
acquisition: One native high branch per frozen case; bind the preaction state, chosen high request and two vehicle IDs. Preserve the actual signal and any clearance extension in the evaluation. Stop on unsafe, irreproducible or incomplete records.
decision: Brier loss (probability minus binary entry indicator, squared), mean over six points then equally over four seeds. Report all controls, per-seed losses and paired differences. Only consider an independent action-contrast study if the candidate has strictly lower overall loss than every control and improves on the same-strength target-only (T+T_pool)/2 in at least three of four seeds. Otherwise close this fixed predictor. This is an exploratory prediction gate.
